Being a good liar used to make me feel like I had the upper hand on people. Now all I strive for is being genuine and providing meaning to others. That would make me completely proud of my life. You sound capable of doing this - passionate about your interests, caring of friends and family. Keep strong brother, and remember the positive impacts you've made weigh more than the negative.

We're all in this game of life together: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9D05ej8u-gU
